newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Louisville, Ky..

text.p: Parking Authority of River City (PARC), Inc.
Bids will be received until 10:00 A.M., E.D.T., on

for the purchase of $30,610,000 (plus or minus up to $3,000,000) principal amount of City of Louisville Parking Authority of River City (PARC), Inc. First Mortgage Revenue Refunding Bonds, Series 1997, dated July 1, 1997. The Bonds shall bear interest from the date thereof, shall mature on December 1, 1998 through 2020 as listed below:
Year of Year of Year of

and shall be subject to the limitations set forth in th Official Terms and Conditions of Sale of the Bonds. Official Terms and Conditions of Sale of Bonds, together with the Preliminary Official Statement and Bid Form may be obtained from the Fiscal Agent, J.J.B. Hilliard, W.L. Lyons, Inc., P.O. Box 32760, Louisville, Kentucky 40232-2760. Bids will be received by the Director of Finance and Budget of the City of Louisville, City Hall, Louisville, Kentucky 40202, and will be acted upon by the President and Secretary of PARC as soon thereafter as reasonably possible. The Bonds will be issued on a tax-exempt basis subject to certain qualifications set out in detail in the Official Terms and Conditions of Sale of Bonds and the Preliminary Official Statement. Good faith deposit is $306,100 (1%). Minimum bid $29,997,800 (98%). Approving Legal Opinion by Rubin & Hays, Municipal Bond Attorneys, Louisville, Kentucky. (Signed) Robert C.Schwoeppe, Director of Finance and Budget, City of Louisville.
